observed.band_method: Offline linear interpolation of observed CSV forces, ZOH logged target, cubic detrend/zero-phase bandpass. Not a controller filter.
observed.limitation: Clipped projected normals as in controller. Deviation from common scalar request is NOT full-wrench/friction margin; logging target and sensor timestamps are not simultaneous.

validation.note: Individual observed normals are real; simulated minima are mean-of-hands only.
